Financial covenants include a Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio and a Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio, both as defined in the 2026 Credit Agreement.

parsed.notes: The excerpt names the two financial covenants under the 2026 Credit Agreement but gives no actual ratios or required levels. It states only that the company was in compliance as of September 30, 2026, so both entries have null values. The directions (maximum for leverage, minimum for coverage) are inferred from the usual covenant structure, not stated in the excerpt. The excerpt also mentions the Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio as the basis for interest margins and commitment fees; those pricing uses were excluded. Covenant headroom is described only as revolver borrowing capacity of $268.7 million at September 30, 2026.
